topic.description: The topic line copied verbatim from the shortlist, so the score can be matched back to the idea

score.description: 0-100. Below 20 means the blog cannot write it honestly today

rationale.description: One line (English, ~140 chars) naming the factor that decided the score

rank.description: 1 = the subject worth today's slot. No ties, no gaps

ranked.description: Every subject from the shortlist, exactly once, best first
